Format Variable Names Using Descriptions

Source: R/help_plot.R
dot-format_variable_names.Rd

Formats variable names using available descriptions for better readability.

Usage

.format_variable_names(
  data,
  variable_col,
  desc_col,
  var_name_by_description = TRUE,
  add_var_info = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing variable and description columns.

variable_col

Name of the column containing variable identifiers.

desc_col

Name of the column containing descriptions.

var_name_by_description

Logical. If TRUE, replaces variable names with descriptions.

add_var_info

Logical. If TRUE, adds additional information in parentheses.

Value

A data frame with formatted variable names.

See also

comparison_plot, detail_plot, stack_plot
